rule: Rosters are evaluation definitions. Membership never changes silently: a new roster is a new cohortsVersion. Weak species are never dropped; a failed evaluation makes the aggregate INCOMPLETE.

ALL_ASSESSED.label: All individually assessed species capability (overall Fish Brain)

overall.why: the complete eligible roster: one strong species cannot hide weak ones; TARGET is shown beside it

notIndividuallyAssessable.carpsuckers_group: registry row covers several carpsucker species (taxonomyStatus GROUP_UNRESOLVED); species-level biology cannot be evaluated for a group. Its proposed species splits (river carpsucker, quillback) join through a new cohort version once they are registry rows.

treatmentRule.rule: An entry is in a capability roster only if it is one biological species. Registry rows whose taxonomyStatus is GROUP_* or TAXON_UNRESOLVED are not individually assessable: explicitly unscored (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or NOT_ASSESSED), listed, never dropped silently. Species with FIELD_ID_UNRESOLVED (identification in the field, e.g. the Buffalo Carp app group) or RESOLVED_HYBRIDIZES are single species and stay in.

appliesTo.carpsuckers_group: GROUP_UNRESOLVED (ASSESSED in the registry) -> moved to notIndividuallyAssessable

treatmentRule.denominatorChange: ALL_ASSESSED 27 -> 26. This removes a 0.00 species and RAISES the aggregate; the v1 figure is reported beside the v2 figure, and the change needs owner approval like the rest of the candidate.
treatmentRule.registryUnchanged: No registry classification, assessment, label or knowledge score is changed; this is an evaluation-roster definition only.
